summary: Frontend-only, narrow regression verification for the /create key-event crash was executed on the public URL. Replayed the reported trace, injected malformed keyboard events, and validated world movement gating with dialog open vs closed.
critical_code_review_comments: WorldEngine.onKey guard (typeof e?.key==='string') and key allowlist prevented the original toLowerCase(undefined) crash during malformed key events.
While form/dialog is open, WASD/Arrow typing in agent-name and agent-strategy no longer moves the player (player x/z unchanged).
After closing dialog via dock-world, lowercase/uppercase WASD and ArrowUp resumed movement; keyup and blur reduced speed to near-zero as expected.
Observed non-blocking navigation behavior: initial page load often hits Playwright load timeout, but DOM content is available and test flows continue normally.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested narrow crash regression checks

context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed only requested scope: replayed /create sequence (category switches, gold avatar, 5-char name, repeated context-menu), malformed keyboard-event injection on window and input, dialog-open movement suppression checks, post-close movement/keyup/blur checks using world-canvas data-world-state player coordinates, and quick mobile smoke. No TypeError/toLowerCase pageerror observed.
rca of the issue: Original crash source was unguarded key normalization (e.key.toLowerCase) when key was undefined in onKey. Current implementation safely exits for non-string keys and non-movement keys, preventing runtime failure under malformed/synthetic keyboard events.
mocked_api: No mocked APIs used in this run.
